title: ConfigFile
description: The config file customizes mock Teams context and optional DirectEngine connection settings. The top-level tenantId is shared by both.

directEngine.description: Optional local DirectEngine connection settings. The tenant ID is read from the top-level tenantId property.

agentType.description: Agent type: copilot for GitHub Copilot or classic for Standard

environmentId.description: Environment GUID, optionally prefixed with Default-

clientId.description: Public-client application ID used for DirectEngine authentication

tenantId.description: The tenant's ID, used for mock Bot Framework APIs (for example, TeamsInfo.getTeamMembers()) and DirectEngine authentication. DirectEngine requires a nonzero tenant GUID unless overridden with --tenant-id.

bot.description: The bot app information. Can be retrieved from activity payload sent to bot message endpoint

agenticUserId.description: The agentic user ID for the bot

agenticAppId.description: The agentic app ID for the bot

tenantId.description: The tenant ID for the bot

users.description: Users in the tenant. By default, these users are all in the group chat and the team

personalChat.description: Personal chat with bot. This chat only contains current user and bot

id.description: Personal chat conversation ID. Can be used to send custom activity to this personal chat

groupChat.description: Group chat information. Currently only support one group chat and contains current user and all the users specified in "users" property

id.description: Group chat conversation ID. Can be used to send custom activty to this group chat

team.description: The team information. Currently only support a single team. Can be retrieved by TeamsInfo.getTeamDetails() in botbuilder SDK

id.description: Team conversation ID. Can be used to send custom activity to the General channel of this team

aadGroupId.description: Azure Active Directory (AAD) group ID for the team.

channels.description: Channels information in the Team. Currently only support one channel in addition to the General channel. Can be retrieved by TeamsInfo.getTeamChannels() in botbuilder SDK. A team always has a General channel. And the General channel conversation ID is the same as the Team ID

User.description: User information. Affects the TeamsChannelAccount object returned from TeamsInfo.getMember(), TeamsInfo.getTeamMembers(), TeamsInfo.getPagedMembers(), etc. [asdf](https://www.google.com)

id.description: User ID. This is the channel id for the user or bot on this Bot Framework channel

aadObjectId.description: This account's Azure Active Directory object ID

id.description: Channel conversation ID. Can be used to send custom activity to this channel
